coastal.title: RCMP pair with helicopter service to target dangerous drivers in Nanaimo
coastal.description: RCMP in Nanaimo partnered with a police helicopter service to target dangerous drivers in the city, following multiple complaints from residents about drag racing and other risky behaviour in some parts of the city in recent months.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire livestock ‘hero’ stopped after breaking the rules
kamloops.description: Animal rescuer Kazimir Nowlin has been working since Friday to get animals and livestock to safety and away from the danger of the massive Bald Range fire.

kamloops.title: B.C. Premier David Eby says visit to Interior ravaged by wildfires was ‘moving’
kamloops.description: Kelly Greene, Minister of Emergency Management and Climate Readiness and Amelia Boultbee, MLA for Penticton-Summerland, will also be in attendance.

kamloops.title: Bald Range wildfire grows again as crews warn of possible winds, thunderstorm
kamloops.description: The Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen Emergency Operations Centre (EOS) said on Wednesday that there are no changes to evacuation orders and alerts at this time.

kamloops.title: Faulder family loses both homes in devastating Summerland wildfire
kamloops.description: Shawna and Lucas Wagner were forced to leave behind what they had envisioned for their future as the newlyweds had only purchased the home in December.

kamloops.title: Surge in overnight calls to Kids Help Phone ‘a canary in the coal mine’: CEO
kamloops.description: Requests via text in the evening and overnight hours are 183 per cent higher than those received during the day, Kids Help Phone said.

kamloops.title: B.C. premier promises review of emergency response to wildfire near Summerland, B.C.
Summerland wildfire evacuees turn to social media for damage details amid lack of official info
kamloops.description: Some wildfire evacuees from Summerland, B.C., say they are seeking out alternative sources of information about the fate of their community to fill an official void, even as authorities warn against the risk of misinformation.

prince-george.title: Dawson Creek homeless shelter seeks to ease community conflict, improve services
prince-george.description: The Aboriginal Housing Management Association is the new operating partner of the Nawican Friendship Centre and emergency homeless shelter in Dawson Creek.

southeast.title: Cranbrook wants a hospice house, but where it should go is up for debate
southeast.description: Cranbrook residents will be surveyed this fall on five possible locations for a proposed 10-bed hospice house, including the Mount Baker RV Campground.
